title: STA9750 Portfolio
text: Hi! My name is Jeffrey Flores, a grad student at Baruch pursuing an M.S. in Statistics. Recently, I graduated with a bachelors in Statistics & Quantitative Modeling  with a minor in Communication Studies. I’m intertested in leveraging my skills within the sports industry and hope to one day contribute to a teams’ success through data. This website will serve as a portfolio to showcase my course projects in STA9750.

  group_by(year) |> 
  summarize(sales=sum(sales)) |>
